prompt:
THE BACKGROUND MUST BE FLAT SOLID MAGENTA #FF00FF, filling every pixel behind the figure, edge to edge. THE BACKGROUND IS NOT WHITE. IT IS NOT OFF-WHITE, IVORY, CREAM, BEIGE, PAPER, LINEN OR ANY PALE COLOUR. If you are about to render a white or near-white background, RENDER PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF INSTEAD. Not a gradient, not a field, not a sky, not a tent, not a wall. No shadow on the backdrop, no ground plane, no frame, no border, no text, no watermark. A previous attempt returned an almost entirely white image and was rejected; the backdrop must be unmistakably hot magenta.

A FULL-LENGTH STANDING FIGURE, HEAD TO FEET, both feet resting at the very bottom edge of the frame, the whole body visible from the top of the hair to the soles of both sandals, filling the height of the frame. NOT a bust, NOT a portrait, NOT cropped at the waist or the knees, NOT a distant tiny figure. A single character, standing, facing the viewer, drawn large and clearly.

Jonathan, son of Saul — a young Israelite prince in his early twenties with a warm open face, a short dark beard and shoulder-length dark brown hair. He wears a DEEP INDIGO-BLUE tunic to the knee over a warm OCHRE-GOLD undershirt, a wide tooled brown leather belt at the waist, and a rich VIOLET-PURPLE cloak fastened at one shoulder and falling behind him. Brown leather sandals. Every garment is saturated and warm — no white, no cream, no pale fabric anywhere on the figure.

HE CARRIES A SIMPLE WOODEN SHORTBOW held calmly at his side in his left hand, pointing DOWN at the ground, with no arrow on the string. A brown leather quiver of arrows is slung across his back, its strap crossing his chest. HE IS NOT AIMING, NOT DRAWING THE BOW, NOT FIGHTING — his posture is friendly and open, his right hand relaxed and slightly extended as if greeting somebody.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading, matching the reference figures exactly in proportion, line weight and palette warmth. Head to feet, full length, both feet at the bottom edge, on FLAT MAGENTA #FF00FF.

Deborah the judge and prophetess — a woman in her forties with a calm steady face, warm brown skin and dark hair mostly covered by a soft saffron-gold head wrap that falls over one shoulder. She wears a long deep olive-green robe to the ankles with an amber sash tied at the waist, and a warm terracotta mantle over her shoulders. Simple leather sandals.

SHE HOLDS A SINGLE GREEN PALM BRANCH upright in her right hand, its fronds spreading above her hand — she sat and judged under the palm of Deborah. Her left hand rests open at her side. Calm, steady, welcoming — NOT armed, NOT fighting, NOT pointing.
